meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 获得了操作浏览器的新能力：替你打开网页、点击链接、填写表单、截图、提取页面文字，还能录制操作视频、对比页面变化。它通过识别页面元素编号来精确操作。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 浏览网页、填写表单或截图时触发；其他浏览器操作（如提取信息、测试网页）也会启用。

say.text: 打开 example.com，把首页截图保存下来
say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器打开该网址并截图。

say.text: 在这个表单里填入测试邮箱和密码并提交
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框填入内容并点击提交。

say.text: 录一段点击“登录”按钮的操作视频
say.note: Claude 会开始录制屏幕操作并保存为视频。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can drive a real browser: open pages, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text, record videos, and compare pages. It identifies page elements by refs to act precisely.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to browse a website, fill a form, take screenshots, or perform other browser tasks such as extracting info or testing web pages.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a screenshot of the homepage
say_en.note: Claude launches the browser, opens the URL, and captures a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill the form with a test email and password, then submit
say_en.note: Claude locates the inputs, types the values, and clicks submit.

say_en.text: Record a video of clicking the 'Sign In' button
say_en.note: Claude starts recording, performs the click, and saves the video.
